findings.message: L113: 🔴 bug: `sub_connect_graph.nodes` is not callable. It should be `sub_connect_graph.nodes()` to get a view of the nodes. This bug prevents the correct merging of graph nodes.

L441: 🔴 bug: `docStoreConn.delete` is a blocking call and should not be directly called within `trio.start_soon` without `trio.to_thread.run_sync`. This can block the event loop and degrade performance. Wrap the call in `trio.to_thread.run_sync`.

L204: 🔴 bug: `.extend()` modifies the list in place and returns `None`, so `sorted(set(None))` will raise an error. The `extend` method should be called directly on the list, then `set` and `sorted` applied to the updated list. This logic is incorrect and will cause a `TypeError` if `node1_attrs['source_id']` is `None` or missing. Ensure `get(attr, [])` is used and then combine correctly.

L204: 🔵 nit: The original code removed `keywords` from merging in `node0_attrs`. This new line should ideally handle both `keywords` and `source_id` similarly, or at least clarify why `keywords` was removed.

L221: 🔴 bug: `.extend()` modifies the list in place and returns `None`, so `set(None)` will raise an error. Combine the lists before applying `set` and `list`. This will result in a `TypeError`. The `get(attr, [])` pattern for missing attributes is good, but the list concatenation needs to be explicit before using `set`.
nit: this diff modifies 3 source file(s) and no test file - if the change is behavior-bearing, point at the coverage that exercises it.
